confidence_rules.A: Reserved for explicit provenance or shared reachable Git ancestry; unavailable in this dataset.
confidence_rules.B: Exact normalized modification, exact anchor family, strict temporal order, and identical non-removal old/new blob transition.
confidence_rules.C: Exact normalized patch and anchor family with strict temporal order, but transition differs or the operation is an addition/removal with low specificity.
confidence_rules.D: Direction indeterminate or required evidence absent; rejected from directed relations.

interpretation: B and C are compatible adoption candidates, not proven transmission edges or origin assignments.
limitations: No relation reaches confidence A because explicit provenance/shared ancestry was not collected.
Commit timestamps establish observed order, not causal transmission.
A common unobserved source can generate identical patches in multiple repositories.
